description: A copied compiler adds dart:developer and dart:isolate solely to probe foundation blockers. This is not supported SDK linkage or runtime acceptance.

isolate_propagation.finding: The parent isolate sees worker replacement, but an unchanged AOT callback in Isolate.run observes baseline worker in the child. A directly transmitted bytecode closure succeeded separately. SDK allow-list expansion alone would be unsound.
isolate_propagation.next: Design cold-start module activation and dispatch initialization for child isolates, then compare both AOT and bytecode callbacks with original-source AOT before admitting dart:isolate.
isolate_propagation.generated_slot_evidence: baseline/app.dart declares int Function(int)? simurghSlot1; simurghInstall assigns the replacement only in the calling isolate. The unchanged compute callback reaches worker through that isolate-local slot.
